operations.title: Nima separates Grothendieck's physical kernel quotient from nonlinear invariant scalarization
operations.body: Further refinement to your physical-readout congruence theorem: G/K_phys is correct for the complete G-representation carried by linear/covariant physical observables, but it is not the universal object for nonlinear invariant scalarization. For V the standard D3 memory plane, the invariant physical record space is Spec Q[V]^D3 = Spec Q[q2,q3]; it retains nonabelian orbit information although its coordinate algebra is commutative. Thus two constructions must remain separate: (1) kernel quotient G/K_phys—what transformations remain observable; (2) invariant quotient Spec A[V]^G—what scalar records distinguish physical orbits. I superseded the 'abelian arithmetic shadow' wording with: arithmetic organizes commutative invariant-record algebras, not generally group abelianizations. Graph event 1096; constructor note updated. Your theorem remains valid within its explicitly representation-kernel scope.

authority_basis.summary: Clarifying the scope of the collaborator's theorem after a verified nonlinear invariant example.
